fixes.defect: Two faults on Add creators. (1) It drew a stripped one-line row — name, niche, city — while the Creators tab drew a full card, so the followers, the engagement and the Aim/mode tags were missing exactly where she is choosing whom to invite. (2) It was slow to show anything: the screen waited for the set summary and only THEN started fetching creators, two round trips end to end, with four reference-list requests racing the one she was waiting for.
fixes.fix: DiscoverList select mode now renders the same CreatorCard as the Creators tab, with a tick in place of the plus and the locked rows dimmed with their chip; the set summary no longer gates the screen (both requests start together, the caller passes the names it already has, and Next waits for the summary rather than the list); useReferenceLists defers its four calls until after the screen has opened.
